name: Amazon Fresh & Amazon Now
tagline: Amazon's grocery delivery, now racing into India quick commerce
facts: Amazon Now orders doubling every quarter
Target 300+ cities using More Retail stores
US Fresh stores closing (2026); same-day grocery 2,300+ towns
Samir Kumar, Amazon India Country Manager

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people find anything they want to buy online.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Make Amazon the default for every grocery mission: minutes (Now), hours (Fresh), days (Pantry-style bulk).

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Bundle groceries into Prime; reuse logistics, More Retail stores and seller base for asset-light scale.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Prime base, payments (Amazon Pay), ad stack and deep pockets to subsidise a late entry.

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Globally Amazon closed Fresh stores; delivery beat physical retail. In India it entered q-comm late but fast.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Can a late entrant with Prime win quick commerce, or is store density a first-mover moat?

customers.pain: Juggling multiple apps for groceries and shopping
customers.why: One app, Prime benefits, trusted returns and Amazon Pay rewards

customers.who: Urban users needing essentials in minutes
customers.pain: Forgot items; e-commerce takes a day
customers.why: Amazon Now tab inside main app, no new download

customers.pain: Want price value and scheduled slots
customers.why: Amazon Fresh slotted delivery, bank offers, Great Indian Festival deals

customers.who: FMCG brands, local partners, More Retail
customers.pain: Need reach beyond metros and ad ROI
customers.why: Amazon Ads, huge traffic, fulfilment network

customers.who: Riders in Amazon Flex and partner fleets
customers.why: Steady volume across Amazon's delivery programs

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: India: seller commissions, fees and ads; globally grocery is part of Amazon online and physical store revenue.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Shoppers pay for goods; sellers pay commissions; brands buy ads; Prime subsidises frequency.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Not disclosed; est. deeply negative in India as Amazon funds launch discounts and store build-out.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Prime cross-sell, 300-city rollout via More stores, ads, festival sales, electronics in minutes.

friction: Amazon Now unavailable in many pin codes
Now vs Fresh vs main app confuses users
Smaller fresh assortment than Blinkit or BigBasket
Marketplace FDI rules limit owning inventory

competitors.label: Quick commerce

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Late entrant vs Blinkit density; regulatory scrutiny on marketplace discounting
